title: The Cofree Functor on G-Sets and Its Approximations
summary: We study the cofree functor on the category of group actions and examine its categorical and combinatorial properties. Motivated by this construction, we introduce a family of functors associated with subgroups and develop their theory through a corresponding coreflective subcategory of group actions. Finally, we investigate the comonad in the category of sets induced by the cofree adjunction and prove that it classifies the groups.
